_note: PUBLICATION preset for the LA web app (2026-09-02) - what actually ships, as opposed to the benchmark-fitting presets. Scoring is identical to seesaw-taste.json (judge .62 / quality .14 / venue .12 / press .06 / closing_soon .06 on the Sonnet judge, threshold .5); read that file's note for how the weights were fitted and for the held-out caveats. Three differences, all about what may reach the built site rather than about ranking: (1) max_n null - publish EVERYTHING above the cutoff, not a top 12; (2) published_only - the pending pool is ranked but webdemo/build.py reads only content/<city>.json, so a pending show that won a feed slot would silently leave the Featured tab short (22 in-window shows are in that pool today); (3) require_open - tools.show_in_window admits shows opening within OPEN_WINDOW_DAYS=7, and 21 published shows today are not yet open; the app's Featured tab should only carry shows a visitor can actually go and see. exclude_museums stays true by the user's explicit choice 2026-09-02: the Featured tab mirrors See Saw and is galleries-only, dropping 17 museum shows including the pool's top-scoring one (The Broad / Yoko Ono, 0.764, judge 9/10). Museums still appear in the app's List and Map tabs - they are simply never featured. Requires full Sonnet judge coverage: judge carries .62 of the score, so judge new shows before every apply or they score near zero and vanish. Result on 2026-09-02: 24 featured, 5 editors picks.
